candidate_reports.remark: Over 12 rip current rescues reported in Avon Tuesday (6/30)_ and around 5 reported Wednesday (7/1).
Multiple rip current rescues reported in Avon today.
Delayed report. A shelter was destroyed at a chicken farm near Kenansville.
42 knot gust measured at the Ballast Point WxFlow station.
Video of hail up to quarter size sent in via social media. Time estimated based on radar.
Delayed report. Tree damage noted at the intersection of Pollock Street and Metcalf Street in downtown New Bern. Report via WCTI.
Power outages reported by dominion energy.
47 knot wind gust measured at the Croatan Sound WxFlow station.
Flooding reported along S Croatan Highway in Nags Head.
